_comment: WP-1411 (UA-09a) world LOD policy as data, read by BatchIsland.Cores.World.LodPolicy and later by CellBuilder (editor glue). Rules (RAP 3.4, PHI 4, CT T14): Mesh LOD on props over 150 triangles; LODGroup only on heroes, vehicles and characters; layerCullDistances Character 80 / Vehicle 160 / Prop 100 scaled per tier; LOD bias 0.7 on Floor; no cross-fade on Floor (haze hides the edge). lod_ratios are the triangle share of each step after LOD0 (proposal). cell_tris_max is the per-cell LOD0 triangle ceiling (row: within 60k per cell). Proposals until measured on the Honor X5b.
